label.zh-CN: 在长安活动
label.en: Active in Chang'an

summary.zh-CN: 长安是玄奘译经、讲学与制度化工作的主要场所。
summary.en: Chang'an was the main setting for Xuanzang's translation, teaching and institutional work.

label.zh-CN: 经过敦煌区域
label.en: Travelled through the Dunhuang region

summary.zh-CN: 敦煌位于跨越河西走廊的求法路线语境中，具体停留节点仍需逐项核定。
summary.en: Dunhuang belongs to the Hexi Corridor context of the pilgrimage route; individual stops still require item-level verification.

label.zh-CN: 与洛阳发生联系
label.en: Connected with Luoyang

summary.zh-CN: 洛阳是隋唐政治与宗教网络中的重要节点；本条只表达区域联系，不等同于固定驻锡。
summary.en: Luoyang was an important political and religious node; this records a regional connection, not a claim of permanent residence.

label.zh-CN: 景云二年入京（长安锚点）
label.en: Summoned to the capital in 711 (Chang'an anchor)

summary.zh-CN: 《旧唐书》记载景云二年睿宗召司马承祯入京；本条只把当时京师的长安作为城市尺度锚点。开元年间涉及东都洛阳、王屋山的召见与建观另行处理，不由本条推成 713–735 年持续在长安活动。
summary.en: The Old Book of Tang records that Ruizong summoned Sima Chengzhen to the capital in 711; this relation uses Chang'an as a city-scale anchor for that episode only. Later Kaiyuan summons involving the eastern capital Luoyang and Mount Wangwu are kept separate and are not turned into continuous activity in Chang'an from 713 to 735.

note.zh-CN: 仅标记景云二年入京的城市尺度锚点；开元九年至十五年的东都、王屋山等活动不纳入本条。
note.en: Marks only the city-scale anchor for the 711 summons; Kaiyuan-era activity at the eastern capital and Mount Wangwu is excluded from this relation.

label.zh-CN: 贞观十四年在长安国子学讲学
label.en: Taught at Chang'an Guozijian in 640

summary.zh-CN: 《碑林区志》记载，贞观十四年（640）唐太宗到长安务本坊国子学，命国子祭酒孔颖达讲《孝经》，并撰定《五经正义》为教材；本条只表达这一有具体机构和年份的长安活动。
summary.en: The Beilin District Gazetteer records that in 640, at the Guozijian in Wuben Ward, Chang'an, Emperor Taizong ordered Guozijian libationer Kong Yingda to lecture on the Classic of Filial Piety and help establish the Corrected Meanings as a textbook; this relation records only that institution- and year-specific activity in Chang'an.

note.zh-CN: 以务本坊国子学这一机构定位为关系边界，不把孔颖达全部 574–648 年生平活动都归入长安。
note.en: The relation is bounded by the Wuben Ward Guozijian locator and does not assign Kong Yingda's entire 574–648 life and activity to Chang'an.

label.en: Connected by an imperial corridor

summary.zh-CN: 长安与洛阳是隋唐政治、交通和宗教传播网络中的核心城市。
summary.en: Chang'an and Luoyang were core cities in Sui–Tang political, transport and religious networks.

label.zh-CN: 比较阅读
label.en: Comparative reading

summary.zh-CN: 本关系只建立策展比较入口，不声称两个文本具有同一作者、同一传统或直接影响关系。
summary.en: This is a curatorial comparison, not a claim of common authorship, common tradition or direct influence.

label.zh-CN: 概念比较入口

summary.en: The texts can be placed side by side, while their terms, historical contexts and religious functions remain distinct.

label.zh-CN: 进入《道德经》注释传统
label.en: Participated in Daodejing commentary

summary.zh-CN: 成玄英提供唐初道家经典解释活动的案例，具体注本版本仍待目录核定。
summary.en: Cheng Xuanying provides a case of early Tang Daoist interpretation; the specific commentary edition still requires catalogue verification.

note.zh-CN: 现存纂疏保留成玄英疏的传承见证；本关系不把辑本当作完整原疏，也不把文本题署扩展为单一作者事实。
note.en: The surviving collected subcommentary preserves a witness to Cheng Xuanying's subcommentary tradition; this does not treat it as a complete original or turn a title attribution into a sole-authorship claim.

label.zh-CN: 宫廷学术制度语境
label.en: Court scholarly institutional context

summary.zh-CN: 颜师古的文本整理活动被置于唐初宫廷学术机构的背景中；具体职任需继续核定。
summary.en: Yan Shigu's editorial work is placed in the setting of early Tang court scholarship; specific office holding remains to be verified.

label.zh-CN: 与洛阳佛教网络相连
label.en: Connected with Luoyang Buddhist networks

summary.zh-CN: 本关系记录隋唐之际人物与洛阳宗教网络的研究入口，不代替逐年行迹。
summary.en: This records a research entry between the figure and Luoyang's religious networks, not a year-by-year itinerary.

label.zh-CN: 与唐初长安制度语境相连
label.en: Connected with the early Tang institutional context of Chang'an

summary.zh-CN: 编年资料记载成玄英 631 年应召前往长安、636 年参与佛道辩论；本关系只保留城市尺度活动锚点，相关一手传记、具体宫观和辩论地点仍待核对。
summary.en: A chronological reference places Cheng Xuanying in Chang'an after a summons in 631 and in a Buddhist–Daoist debate in 636; this retains a city-scale activity anchor while primary biography, specific institutions and debate site remain to be verified.

note.zh-CN: 这是编年参考支持的城市尺度锚点，不等同于已核实的具体宫观坐标。
note.en: This is a city-scale anchor supported by a chronological reference, not a verified coordinate for a specific Daoist institution.

label.zh-CN: 与隋末唐初京师寺院网络相连
label.en: Connected with the capital monastic networks of the late Sui and early Tang

summary.zh-CN: 《续高僧传》记载吉藏由隋末至唐初进入京师寺院网络，并在武德年间继续受到礼遇；这里以长安作城市尺度锚点，不把嘉祥寺或日严寺的具体现代位置混为一处。
summary.en: The Continued Biographies records Jizang's connection with capital monastic networks from the late Sui into the early Tang; Chang'an is used as a city-scale anchor without collapsing Jiaxiang Monastery and Riyan Monastery into one modern location.

note.zh-CN: 长安为城市尺度投影；嘉祥寺的现代地点、日严寺的具体建筑和逐年行迹仍待拆分。
note.en: Chang'an is a city-scale projection; Jiaxiang's modern location, the specific Riyan building and a year-by-year itinerary remain to be separated.

label.zh-CN: 以长安为城市范围
label.en: Located within Chang'an's urban scope

summary.zh-CN: 该网络汇总长安不同时期的译场，具体寺院和建筑位置仍须项目级拆分。
summary.en: The network groups translation bureaux in Chang'an across periods; monasteries and building locations remain project-specific.

label.zh-CN: 以长安为城市范围
label.en: Located within Chang'an's urban scope

summary.zh-CN: 网络条目表示城市尺度的宫观联系，不把全部节点归为同一机构。
summary.en: The network records city-scale institutional links without treating all nodes as one institution.

label.zh-CN: 位于历史长安范围
label.en: Located within historical Chang'an

summary.zh-CN: 遗址属于长安城市空间；精确历史坊区与保护边界需由权威地理资料补充。
summary.en: The site belongs to Chang'an's urban space; historical ward and conservation boundary need authoritative geographic records.

label.zh-CN: 位于洛阳以南

summary.zh-CN: UNESCO 遗产资料将龙门石窟定位于古都洛阳以南的伊河两岸。
summary.en: UNESCO heritage documentation locates Longmen on both banks of the Yi River south of ancient Luoyang.

summary.en: Xuanzang's biographical record is connected to the departure event; the month, permission narrative and first route segment remain uncertain.

label.zh-CN: 参与归返长安事件
label.en: Participated in the return to Chang'an

summary.zh-CN: 玄奘的求法经历在约 645 年回到长安后进入译经、讲学和寺院制度语境。
summary.en: After returning to Chang'an around 645, Xuanzang's pilgrimage experience entered translation, teaching and monastic institutional contexts.

label.zh-CN: 出发于长安
label.en: Departure occurred at Chang'an

summary.zh-CN: 事件以长安为出发地理锚点；路线离开城市后的具体节点不由此关系推定。
summary.en: Chang'an is the geographic anchor for the departure; this relation does not infer the specific nodes after leaving the city.

label.zh-CN: 归返长安
label.en: Return occurred at Chang'an

summary.zh-CN: 约 645 年的归返事件把跨区域路线接回长安城市和制度空间。
summary.en: The return around 645 reconnects the transregional route with Chang'an's urban and institutional space.

label.zh-CN: 建立于长安
label.en: Foundation occurred in Chang'an

summary.zh-CN: 大慈恩寺建立事件以长安为城市尺度地点，并与后续玄奘译经空间分开建模。
summary.en: The foundation event is anchored at Chang'an at city scale and is modelled separately from Xuanzang's later translation sites.

label.zh-CN: 在大慈恩寺译经与讲学
label.en: Active at Great Ci'en Monastery

summary.zh-CN: 大慈恩寺是玄奘回到长安后译经、讲学和制度化工作的核心机构节点；具体译经项目另行连接文本和版本。
summary.en: Great Ci'en Monastery is a core institutional node for Xuanzang's translation, teaching and institutional work after his return; individual translation projects will link separately to texts and versions.

label.zh-CN: 进入长安译经场网络
label.en: Situated in Chang'an's translation-bureau network

summary.zh-CN: 玄奘的译经工作依托寺院、语言分工、校勘和制度支持；这里连接的是网络语境，不把不同项目合并为一处固定建筑。
summary.en: Xuanzang's translation work relied on monastic space, language roles, textual checking and institutional support; this connects a network context rather than one fixed building.

label.zh-CN: 见闻与传述关联玄奘
label.en: Travel knowledge associated with Xuanzang

summary.zh-CN: 《大唐西域记》与玄奘的旅行见闻和口述传统相关，但文本并不因此被简化为玄奘单独写作。
summary.en: The Record is connected to Xuanzang's travel observations and transmitted accounts, but is not reduced to sole authorship by Xuanzang.

note.zh-CN: 人物见闻、口述与编纂者之间的层次仍需按版本和研究文献细分。
note.en: The layers among personal observation, transmitted account and compiler still require edition- and scholarship-level separation.

label.zh-CN: 在大慈恩寺记忆中延续
label.en: Remembered through Great Ci'en Monastery

summary.zh-CN: 大慈恩寺作为译经与寺院网络节点承接玄奘的后世机构记忆；本条不等同于神格化或单一纪念仪式。
summary.en: Great Ci'en Monastery carries institutional memory of Xuanzang through translation and monastic networks; this does not assert deification or one single commemorative ritual.

label.zh-CN: 路线经过敦煌区域
label.en: Route connects through the Dunhuang region

summary.zh-CN: 路线把敦煌作为河西走廊的区域锚点，而不是主张已复原逐日行程。
summary.en: The route uses Dunhuang as a regional anchor in the Hexi Corridor rather than claiming a reconstructed day-by-day itinerary.

label.zh-CN: 处于开元制度扩展语境
label.en: Situated in the Kaiyuan institutional-expansion context

summary.zh-CN: 司马承祯与开元时期的宫廷召见、道教制度和知识网络相连；该事件是研究性阶段标签，不是一次单独行程。
summary.en: Sima Chengzhen is connected with the Kaiyuan courtly, Daoist and knowledge networks; this event is an analytical period label rather than one itinerary.

note.zh-CN: 把人物与分析性时代带相连，不等于证明每一项制度变化都由司马承祯参与。
note.en: This links the figure to an analytical period and does not claim that he participated in every institutional change within it.

label.zh-CN: 连接长安道教宫观网络
label.en: Connected with Chang'an's Daoist institutional network

summary.zh-CN: 司马承祯的道教身份与唐代城市、宫廷和道观制度网络相连，但网络条目不代表一处固定宫观。
summary.en: Sima Chengzhen's Daoist identity is connected with Tang urban, courtly and monastic networks without reducing the network to one fixed monastery.

label.zh-CN: 在司马承祯的道教语境中被接收
label.en: Received within Sima Chengzhen's Daoist context

summary.zh-CN: 《道德经》与司马承祯所处的上清传统和唐代道教解释语境相连；这不是把文本作者归于司马承祯。
summary.en: The Daodejing is connected with Sima Chengzhen's Shangqing and Tang Daoist interpretive context; this is not an authorship claim.

note.zh-CN: 后续需补具体唐代注本、法脉和版本定位。
note.en: Specific Tang commentaries, lineage records and edition locators still need to be added.

label.zh-CN: 在长安道教机构记忆中延续
label.en: Remembered through Chang'an's Daoist institutions

summary.zh-CN: 司马承祯的后世记忆通过道教人物谱系、宫观网络和唐代制度叙事延续；本条不等同于神格化。
summary.en: Later memory of Sima Chengzhen continues through Daoist lineages, institutional networks and Tang histories; this does not assert deification.

label.zh-CN: 参与《五经正义》编纂工程
label.en: Participated in the Corrected Meanings project

summary.zh-CN: 孔颖达与《五经正义》的编纂、注疏和国家教育工程相连；编纂并非个人独著行为。
summary.en: Kong Yingda is connected with the compilation, commentary and state-education project of the Corrected Meanings; the compilation was not a solitary authorship act.

note.zh-CN: 人物参与编纂与注疏，不等于整部文本由一人独立完成。
note.en: The figure's participation in compilation and commentary does not make the composite work a single-author text.

label.zh-CN: 在长安制度空间中展开
label.en: Developed within Chang'an's institutional space

summary.zh-CN: 《五经正义》编纂工程与长安的国家教育和经学制度空间相连；具体场所和阶段仍需拆分。
summary.en: The Corrected Meanings project is connected with Chang'an's state-learning and classical institutions; specific sites and phases still need to be separated.

label.zh-CN: 连接国子监经学制度
label.en: Connected with the Guozijian classical-learning system

summary.zh-CN: 孔颖达的人物活动放回国子监和国家教育制度后，才能看见经学注疏如何获得制度作用；具体官职和校舍仍待核定。
summary.en: Placing Kong Yingda within the Guozijian and state-learning system shows how commentary gained institutional force; exact offices and buildings remain to be verified.

label.zh-CN: 参与经学注疏
label.en: Contributed to classical commentary

summary.zh-CN: 孔颖达与《五经正义》的注疏和编纂层相连，但文本条目保留其复合和集体生产性质。
summary.en: Kong Yingda is connected with the commentary and compilation layers of the Corrected Meanings while the text remains marked as composite and collectively produced.

label.zh-CN: 编纂与注疏贡献关联孔颖达
label.en: Compilation and commentary associated with Kong Yingda

summary.zh-CN: 《五经正义》传统上与孔颖达的编纂和注疏贡献相连，但文本本身是复合的制度性成果，不应简化为个人独著。
summary.en: The Corrected Meanings is associated with Kong Yingda's editorial and commentarial contribution, but remains a composite institutional work rather than a sole-authored book.

note.zh-CN: 人物贡献与文本总体作者身份分开建模。
note.en: The figure's contribution is modelled separately from the work's composite authorship.

label.zh-CN: 进入国子监教育语境
label.en: Received within the Guozijian educational context

summary.zh-CN: 《五经正义》通过经学教学和国家教育制度获得后续传播语境；具体课程和版本使用仍需逐项核对。
summary.en: The Corrected Meanings entered later circulation through classical teaching and state education; specific curricula and edition use still require item-level checking.

label.zh-CN: 在国子监经学记忆中延续
label.en: Remembered through Guozijian classical learning

summary.zh-CN: 孔颖达的后世机构记忆与《五经正义》及国家教育叙事相连；本条不把制度记忆等同于个人崇拜。
summary.en: Institutional memory of Kong Yingda is connected with the Corrected Meanings and state-learning narratives; this is not a claim of personal cult.

label.zh-CN: 出现在孔子问礼叙事中
label.en: Appears in the Confucius–Laozi rites-asking tradition

summary.zh-CN: 《史记》把老子置于孔子向周地问礼的叙事中；本条保留史传和传统层，不把会见当作独立可证的现场记录。
summary.en: The Shiji places Laozi in the narrative of Confucius asking about rites in Zhou; this retains the historiographical and traditional layer rather than treating the encounter as independently verified field evidence.

note.zh-CN: 人物出现在史传事件中，不等于会见细节已被同时代材料独立证实。
note.en: Appearance in a historiographical event does not independently verify the details of the encounter.

label.zh-CN: 在周地向老子问礼
label.en: Asks Laozi about rites in Zhou

summary.zh-CN: 孔子问礼故事由《史记》保存为儒道相遇的史传入口；具体年代和对话细节仍标为传统叙事。
summary.en: The Shiji preserves the rites-asking story as a historiographical entry into a Dao–Ru encounter; exact dating and dialogue details remain traditional.

displayDate.en: Traditional account: late Spring and Autumn period; date uncertain

summary.en: The event uses Luoyang as a city-scale anchor for the Zhou rites and travel context without claiming a precisely located meeting site.

displayDate.zh-CN: 传统叙事：春秋晚期；地点为城市级语境

note.en: Luoyang is a city-scale Zhou anchor, not a confirmed palace or archive location.

label.zh-CN: 与周地礼学语境相连
label.en: Connected with the Zhou rites context

summary.zh-CN: 老子在史传中与周王室藏室和问礼叙事相连；这里使用洛阳作为城市级传统语境，不把传说行迹写成精确驻留。
summary.en: Laozi is connected in historiographical tradition with the Zhou archive and rites-asking narrative; Luoyang is used as a city-scale traditional context, not as a precise residence claim.

displayDate.zh-CN: 传统叙事：春秋晚期；年代不确

label.zh-CN: 与周地问礼语境相连
label.en: Connected with the Zhou rites-asking context

summary.zh-CN: 孔子问礼于周的史传叙事可以用洛阳作为城市级空间入口，但不等于复原一条确定的旅行路线。
summary.en: The historiographical account of Confucius asking about rites in Zhou can use Luoyang as a city-scale spatial entry without reconstructing a certain travel route.

displayDate.zh-CN: 传统叙事：春秋晚期；年代不确
displayDate.en: Traditional account: late Spring and Autumn period; date uncertain

label.zh-CN: 传统上归于老子
label.en: Traditionally attributed to Laozi

summary.zh-CN: 《道德经》传统上与老子相连，但文本成书、编纂和作者归属仍有多层历史，不能简化为老子一人独著。
summary.en: The Daodejing is traditionally connected with Laozi, but its formation, compilation and attribution remain layered and cannot be reduced to sole authorship by one person.

note.zh-CN: 人物传统归属与文本复合成书分开建模。
note.en: Traditional figure attribution and composite textual formation are modelled separately.

label.zh-CN: 传统上作为老子言说保存
label.en: Preserved traditionally as a saying of Laozi

summary.zh-CN: 《道德经》第一章可作为老子传统的代表性言说入口，但 passage 的版本和传述层优先于直接口述假设。
summary.en: Daodejing chapter 1 can serve as a representative speech entry for the Laozi tradition, while version and transmission layers take priority over assuming direct oral attestation.

note.zh-CN: 这是传世本段落的传统归属，不等于可还原为人物当场逐字记录。
note.en: This is a traditional attribution of a received passage, not a recoverable verbatim record of the historical person speaking.

label.zh-CN: 在唐代道教机构记忆中延续
label.en: Remembered through Tang Daoist institutions

summary.zh-CN: 老子作为经典源头和道教传统人物进入唐代宫观、皇室与制度记忆；本条不等同于把李耳直接神格化为同一实体。
summary.en: Laozi as a classical source figure enters Tang institutional, imperial and Daoist memory; this does not collapse Li Er into a single later sacralised identity.

displayDate.zh-CN: 618–907 的唐代道教机构记忆语境

label.zh-CN: 作为道家经典源头进入开元语境
label.en: Enters the Kaiyuan context as a Daoist classical source

summary.zh-CN: 这条关系表达后世经典和制度接受的策展连接，不主张老子本人参与开元时期每一项制度变化。
summary.en: This relation expresses a curatorial connection through later textual and institutional reception, not personal participation in every Kaiyuan-era change.

label.zh-CN: 保存孔子及弟子言行
label.en: Preserves sayings and actions associated with Confucius and his disciples

summary.zh-CN: 《论语》以孔子及弟子言行为核心，但属于复合传述文本；关系标明由他人记录和编纂，而非单一作者逐字写作。
summary.en: The Analects centres on sayings and actions associated with Confucius and his disciples, but is a composite transmitted text recorded and compiled by others rather than a single-author transcript.

note.zh-CN: 孔子作为说话者的传统归属与《论语》的复合编纂层分开显示。
note.en: The traditional speaker attribution to Confucius is shown separately from the Analects' composite compilation layers.

label.zh-CN: 作为孔子言说由传述保存
label.en: Preserved as a saying of Confucius through transmission

summary.zh-CN: 《学而》篇的开篇言说以孔子为传统说话者，但其文本保存经过弟子、编纂和传本层。
summary.en: The opening of Xue Er is traditionally voiced by Confucius, while its preservation passes through disciples, compilation and received editions.

label.zh-CN: 在国家经学教育记忆中延续
label.en: Remembered through state classical education

summary.zh-CN: 孔子通过经典、注疏和国家教育制度进入唐代经学记忆；这一关系表达后世制度接收，不把孔子写成唐代机构的在场人物。
summary.en: Confucius enters Tang classical-learning memory through classics, commentary and state education; this records later institutional reception rather than placing him physically in a Tang institution.

displayDate.zh-CN: 618–907 的唐代经学制度记忆语境

label.zh-CN: 作为经典传统源头进入《五经正义》工程
label.en: Enters the Corrected Meanings project as a classical source figure

summary.zh-CN: 孔子与《五经正义》的关系是后世经典接受和制度化解释的长链，不是孔子本人参与唐代编纂工程。
summary.en: The connection between Confucius and the Corrected Meanings is a chain of later classical reception and institutional interpretation, not personal participation in a Tang compilation project.

label.zh-CN: 在孔颖达的唐代经学语境中被接收
label.en: Received within Kong Yingda's Tang classical-learning context

summary.zh-CN: 《论语》进入孔颖达所处的经学、注疏和国家教育语境；这条关系表达后世解释，不把孔颖达与孔子合并。
summary.en: The Analects enters the classical, commentarial and state-learning context associated with Kong Yingda; this is later interpretation, not a merging of Kong Yingda with Confucius.

label.zh-CN: 在鹿野苑初转法轮传统中说法
label.en: Teaches in the Sarnath first-sermon tradition

summary.zh-CN: 早期佛教文本把佛陀与鹿野苑初转法轮相连；关系保留文本传述和传统年代层，不声称逐字现场记录。
summary.en: Early Buddhist texts connect the Buddha with the first turning at Sarnath; the relation retains transmitted and traditional dating layers rather than claiming a verbatim record.

summary.en: Sarnath is the first-teaching location in textual and later heritage memory; the real coordinate points to a site-level referent, not a preserved fifth-century BCE scene.

summary.en: The figure–place connection comes from the first-teaching tradition and later heritage memory; it is not a fully reconstructed personal itinerary.

label.en: Preserved as Śākyamuni's teaching through transmission

label.zh-CN: 在鹿野苑朝圣与遗址记忆中延续
label.en: Remembered through Sarnath pilgrimage and heritage

summary.zh-CN: 鹿野苑把佛陀初转法轮的经文传统转化为持续的遗址、朝圣和文化遗产记忆；本条不把后世记忆倒写成同时代事实。
summary.en: Sarnath turns the first-teaching tradition into continuing site, pilgrimage and heritage memory; later memory is not projected back as contemporaneous fact.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约公元前 3 世纪至公元 12 世纪的遗址与朝圣记忆发展

label.zh-CN: 以佛陀形象进入后世般若经典语境
label.en: Represents the Buddha within a later Prajñāpāramitā context

summary.zh-CN: 《心经》的后世经典语境把佛陀置于般若教法和菩萨问答框架中；这是文学与宗教传统中的再呈现，不是释迦牟尼的直接作者署名。
summary.en: The later scriptural context of the Heart Sutra places the Buddha within a Prajñāpāramitā teaching and question-and-answer frame; this is literary and religious representation, not direct authorship by Śākyamuni.

note.zh-CN: 后世经典中的佛陀形象与历史人物、早期经文传述分开建模。
note.en: The Buddha's later scriptural representation remains separate from the historical person and early discourse transmission.

label.zh-CN: 作为佛教教法源头进入大慈恩寺制度语境
label.en: Enters the Great Ci'en institutional context as a source of Buddhist teaching

summary.zh-CN: 这条关系表达唐代寺院和译经制度对佛教源头的后世接收，不主张释迦牟尼本人参与大慈恩寺建立。
summary.en: This relation expresses later Tang monastic and translation-institutional reception of Buddhist origins, not personal participation by Śākyamuni in the monastery's foundation.

label.zh-CN: 对应大慈恩寺机构

summary.zh-CN: 建立事件与大慈恩寺机构条目保持分层：事件表达约 648 年的建立语境，机构条目承载后续译经、寺院网络与空间说明。
summary.en: The foundation event remains distinct from the Great Ci'en institution: the event marks the c. 648 foundation context while the institution carries later translation, monastic-network and spatial description.

label.zh-CN: 参与唐朝建立的政治过程

summary.zh-CN: 李世民与 617–618 年唐朝建立的政治过程相连；关系只表达其参与和制度语境，不把王朝建立归因于单一人物。
summary.en: Li Shimin is connected to the political process of Tang state formation in 617–618; this records participation and context rather than attributing the dynasty's foundation to one person.

note.zh-CN: 关系表达参与，不等同于唯一创立者或单线因果。
note.en: The relation records participation, not sole authorship or a single causal line.

label.zh-CN: 在长安政治制度语境中活动
label.en: Active in Chang'an's political and institutional context

summary.zh-CN: 长安是李世民即位后政治、教育与宗教制度交汇的城市尺度节点；本关系不推定具体宫殿、常住轨迹或单一机构关系。
summary.en: Chang'an was a city-scale node where political, educational and religious institutions converged after Li Shimin's accession; this does not infer a specific palace, residence pattern or single institutional tie.

label.zh-CN: 建立武周的政治转型
label.en: Participated in the political transition that established Wu Zhou

summary.zh-CN: 武曌与 690 年武周建立这一政治转型直接相连；本关系只锚定制度事件，不从身份推导单一宗教动机。
summary.en: Wu Zhao is directly connected to the political transition that established Wu Zhou in 690; this anchors an institutional event without inferring a single religious motive from identity.

note.zh-CN: 政策、仪式与宗教赞助需拆分为各自的后续关系。
note.en: Policies, rituals and religious patronage require separate follow-up relations.

label.zh-CN: 在洛阳两京制度语境中活动

summary.zh-CN: 690 年定鼎洛邑使洛阳成为武周政治与仪式表达的重要城市节点；本关系不等同于覆盖武曌全部生涯的固定居住断言。
summary.en: The 690 designation of Luoyang as a capital makes it an important urban node for Wu Zhou politics and ritual representation; this is not a claim of fixed residence across Wu Zhao's entire life.

label.zh-CN: 由海路出发求法

summary.en: Yijing is connected to the c. 671 maritime pilgrimage departure; the biographical material supports the maritime direction and transregional journey, while the departure port remains to be verified separately.

note.zh-CN: 海路起点和中途港口不由此关系自动补全。
note.en: The maritime origin and intermediate ports are not auto-filled by this relation.

summary.zh-CN: 义净与约 695 年携梵本经回到河洛的归返节点相连；“河洛”保留为区域表达，不在此处压缩为单一城市。
summary.en: Yijing is connected to the c. 695 return with Sanskrit scriptures to the He-Luo region; “He-Luo” remains a regional expression rather than being collapsed into one city here.

note.zh-CN: 归返后的具体抵达城市和译经项目需另行连接。
note.en: The specific arrival city and translation projects after the return require separate links.

label.zh-CN: 与那烂陀学习网络相连

summary.zh-CN: 资料将义净约 675 年到达那烂陀并停留十年作为学习节点；地图只显示那烂陀这一地点，不推定其完整南亚路线。
summary.en: The sources place Yijing's arrival at Nalanda around 675 and a decade of study there; the map shows Nalanda as a learning node without inferring his full South Asian itinerary.

label.zh-CN: 参与《五经正义》校定与编纂
label.en: Participated in the collation and compilation of the Corrected Meanings of the Five Classics

summary.zh-CN: 《贞观政要》记载颜师古先考定五经，后与孔颖达等参与《五经正义》编纂；本关系保留协作过程，不把颜师古表述为唯一作者。
summary.en: The Essentials of Government records Yan Shigu's collation of the Classics and later participation with Kong Yingda and others in the Corrected Meanings project; this preserves the collaborative process rather than naming Yan its sole author.

note.zh-CN: 具体分工、校定步骤和最终版本流传仍需继续拆分。
note.en: Specific roles, editorial steps and the later transmission of the final edition still require further separation.

label.zh-CN: 处于《庄子》文本形成传统中
label.en: Participated in the Zhuangzi textual horizon

summary.zh-CN: 人物庄周与《庄子》文本传统相连，但事件表示形成区间，不主张单一作者完成全书。
summary.en: Zhuang Zhou is connected with the Zhuangzi textual tradition, while the event marks a formation range rather than sole authorship of the whole work.

note.zh-CN: 人物生平与文本层次保持分开。
note.en: Biography and textual layers remain separate.

summary.en: Mengcheng is a regional anchor between the Zhuangzi tradition and modern geography, not a precisely located scene of textual formation.

summary.en: The Zhuangzi preserves composite layers of sayings and thought associated with Zhuang Zhou rather than a verbatim work by one figure.

label.zh-CN: 在成玄英的唐代解释传统中被接收
label.en: Received through Cheng Xuanying's Tang interpretive tradition

summary.zh-CN: 庄子传统在唐代解释和道教知识网络中继续被接收；这条关系表达后世解释，不合并两位人物。
summary.en: The Zhuangzi tradition was received in Tang interpretation and Daoist knowledge networks; this is later reception, not a merging of the two figures.

label.zh-CN: 参与游说与讲学传统
label.en: Participated in itinerant counsel and teaching

summary.zh-CN: 孟子人物入口通过游历诸侯和论政言说连接事件与文本，但不绘制未经核实的逐站路线。
summary.en: The Mencius entry connects itinerant counsel and political speech to event and text without drawing an unverified stop-by-stop route.

label.zh-CN: 以邹城作为地域传统锚点
label.en: Uses Zoucheng as a regional tradition anchor

summary.zh-CN: 邹城在地图中表示孟子传统的地域入口，不主张所有游说事件均发生于此。
summary.en: Zoucheng represents the regional gateway of the Mencius tradition and does not claim that every counsel event occurred there.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约公元前 4 世纪的地域传统入口
displayDate.en: Regional tradition gateway, c. fourth century BCE

label.zh-CN: 与邹城地域传统相连
label.en: Connected with the Zoucheng regional tradition

summary.zh-CN: 邹城作为城市尺度锚点把孟子人物入口连接到现实地图，具体行迹仍需按国家与地点分别核对。
summary.en: Zoucheng connects the Mencius entry to the real map at city scale; specific itineraries require separate state- and place-level review.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约公元前 4 世纪的区域关联
displayDate.en: Regional association, c. fourth century BCE

label.zh-CN: 由《孟子》传述与编纂文本表现

label.zh-CN: 在昆仑仙境象征空间中延续
label.en: Remembered through Kunlun immortality space

summary.zh-CN: 西王母的神话与艺术记忆通过昆仑象征空间延续，不进入现实地图。
summary.en: Xi Wangmu's mythic and artistic memory continues through Kunlun symbolic space rather than the real map.

displayDate.zh-CN: 神话与后世艺术记忆层

label.zh-CN: 由神话与神圣宇宙叙事文本表现
label.en: Represented through mythic and sacred cosmological narratives

summary.zh-CN: 相关文本提供西王母、昆仑和仙境传统的记忆入口，而不是历史人物传记。
summary.en: The texts provide a memory entry into Xi Wangmu, Kunlun and immortality traditions rather than a historical biography.

label.zh-CN: 处于太上老君神格化形成层
label.en: Participated in the formation layer of Taishang Laojun sacralisation

summary.zh-CN: 太上老君作为独立神圣身份进入道教神格化和天界谱系，不与老子人物节点合并。
summary.en: Taishang Laojun enters Daoist sacralisation and celestial genealogy as a distinct sacred identity rather than merging with Laozi's figure node.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 200–700 的后世神格化层

label.zh-CN: 进入道教天界象征空间
label.en: Enters Daoist celestial symbolic space

summary.zh-CN: 道教天界是神圣宇宙节点，不是现实地图上的地理位置。
summary.en: The Daoist celestial realm is a sacred-cosmos node, not a geographic location on the real map.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 200–700 的后世神格化层

label.zh-CN: 在道教天界象征空间中延续
label.en: Remembered through the Daoist celestial realm

summary.zh-CN: 太上老君通过道教经典和神圣谱系在天界象征空间中延续，与老子保持身份分层。
summary.en: Taishang Laojun continues through Daoist scriptures and sacred genealogy in celestial symbolic space while remaining distinct from Laozi.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 200–700 的神圣谱系与记忆层

label.zh-CN: 由道教宇宙叙事文本表现
label.en: Represented through Daoist cosmological narratives

summary.zh-CN: 相关文本表现太上老君的神圣谱系和宇宙秩序层，不把它回写成老子历史言论。
summary.en: The texts represent Taishang Laojun's sacred genealogy and cosmic-order layer without writing it back as Laozi's historical speech.

label.zh-CN: 在后世道教传统中神格化为太上老君
label.en: Deified as Taishang Laojun in later Daoist traditions

summary.zh-CN: 老子与太上老君保持两个节点；该关系只表达后世神格化，不把天界身份写回老子历史生平。
summary.en: Laozi and Taishang Laojun remain two nodes; this relation expresses later sacralisation without writing celestial identity back into Laozi's historical biography.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 200–700 的后世神格化层

note.zh-CN: 身份分层：老子 ≠ 太上老君。
note.en: Identity layering: Laozi is not Taishang Laojun.

label.zh-CN: 在襄阳组织僧团与译经活动
label.en: Organised monastic and translation activity in Xiangyang

summary.zh-CN: 襄阳是道安东晋佛教网络的城市尺度活动锚点；本条不主张每一项活动都能定位到同一城内地点。
summary.en: Xiangyang is a city-scale activity anchor for Dao'an's Eastern Jin Buddhist network; the relation does not place every activity at one site within the city.

label.zh-CN: 与长安译经制度发生联系
label.en: Connected with Chang'an translation institutions

summary.zh-CN: 长安作为译经和僧团制度的城市尺度节点，连接道安网络与后秦时期的翻译传统；不将道安全部生平归入长安。
summary.en: Chang'an is a city-scale node for translation and monastic institutions connecting Dao'an's network with later Qin translation traditions; it does not assign Dao'an's whole life to Chang'an.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 365–385 年的译经网络层

note.zh-CN: 长安是制度网络锚点，不是道安完整行迹。
note.en: Chang'an is an institutional-network anchor, not Dao'an's complete itinerary.

label.zh-CN: 组织并参与译经网络
label.en: Organised and participated in the translation network

summary.zh-CN: 事件层把道安、参与者和译场分开，人物关系只表达其组织与参与位置。
summary.en: The event keeps Dao'an, collaborators and translation settings distinct; this relation records his organising and participating role.

label.zh-CN: 发生于襄阳网络语境
label.en: Located in the Xiangyang network context

summary.zh-CN: 襄阳是事件的城市尺度地点锚点，不把译经活动压缩为单一寺院坐标。
summary.en: Xiangyang is the event's city-scale place anchor rather than a claim that all translation activity occurred at one monastery coordinate.

label.zh-CN: 连接长安译经制度空间
label.en: Connects with Chang'an's translation-institution space

summary.zh-CN: 长安是事件的制度网络锚点；本条不把襄阳与长安之间重建成未经核实的连续路线。
summary.en: Chang'an is the event's institutional-network anchor; this does not reconstruct an unverified continuous route between Xiangyang and Chang'an.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 365–385 年的制度空间层

label.zh-CN: 形成师承与法脉影响
label.en: Shaped a teacher–student and lineage influence

summary.zh-CN: 慧远与道安的关系以传记中的师承和法脉影响表达；后世宗派归类不被当作唯一解释。
summary.en: The relation follows biographical teacher–student and lineage influence; later school labels are not treated as the only interpretation.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 365–385 年的师承网络层

note.zh-CN: 关系表达影响与师承，不把慧远后世地位回写到道安时代。
note.en: Records influence and lineage without projecting Huiyuan's later status back into Dao'an's period.

label.zh-CN: 在庐山组织东林僧团
label.en: Organised the Donglin community at Mount Lu

summary.zh-CN: 庐山是慧远僧团、东林寺和佛教文化景观的现实地点锚点。
summary.en: Mount Lu is the real-place anchor for Huiyuan's community, Donglin and Buddhist cultural landscape.

label.zh-CN: 组织东林寺僧团
label.en: Organised the Donglin community

summary.zh-CN: 慧远是东林事件的人物组织者；寺院制度、参与者和后世接受史保持分层。
summary.en: Huiyuan is the organising figure in the Donglin event; institutional, participant and later-reception layers remain distinct.

label.zh-CN: 发生于庐山
label.en: Located at Mount Lu

summary.zh-CN: 东林寺创建以庐山为现实文化景观锚点。
summary.en: Donglin's foundation uses Mount Lu as its real cultural-landscape anchor.

label.zh-CN: 同时代交流与思想网络
label.en: Contemporary exchange and intellectual network

summary.zh-CN: 慧远与鸠摩罗什在 5 世纪初形成书信与思想交流语境；本条不主张来源未明确支持的直接会面。
summary.en: Huiyuan and Kumarajiva belonged to an early fifth-century correspondence and intellectual context; this does not claim a direct meeting unsupported by the sources.

note.zh-CN: 同时代与交流网络，不等同于直接会面。
note.en: Contemporaneity and exchange network, not a direct meeting.

label.zh-CN: 隐居与著述于茅山
label.en: Lived and wrote in the Mount Mao setting

summary.zh-CN: 茅山是陶弘景隐居、著述与道教知识记忆的主要现实山地锚点。
summary.en: Mount Mao is the principal real mountain anchor for Tao Hongjing's reclusion, writings and Daoist knowledge memory.

label.zh-CN: 与建康梁廷保持咨询联系
label.en: Maintained consultation links with the Jiankang court

summary.zh-CN: 建康只表达陶弘景与梁廷的制度和书信联系，不把他写成持续驻守宫廷的官员。
summary.en: Jiankang records Tao Hongjing's institutional and correspondence link with the Liang court without making him a continuously resident court official.

note.zh-CN: 建康是宫廷联系锚点，茅山是主要活动空间。
note.en: Jiankang is the court-connection anchor; Mount Mao is the principal activity setting.

label.zh-CN: 参与茅山隐居与宫廷咨询
label.en: Participated in the Mount Mao and court-consultation episode

summary.zh-CN: 事件把隐居空间与宫廷书信关系并置，人物关系不消除二者的尺度差异。
summary.en: The event places reclusion and court correspondence together while preserving their different spatial scales.

label.zh-CN: 以茅山为主要空间
label.en: Centred on the Mount Mao setting

summary.zh-CN: 茅山是事件的主要现实山地锚点，建康联系另以人物和事件关系呈现。
summary.en: Mount Mao is the event's principal real mountain anchor; the Jiankang connection is represented separately through figure and event relations.

label.zh-CN: 书信与宫廷咨询往来
label.en: Correspondence and court consultation

summary.zh-CN: 陶弘景与梁武帝通过书信和知识咨询形成同时代联系；本条不把咨询关系写成正式官职或持续同处。
summary.en: Tao Hongjing and Liang Wudi were connected through correspondence and knowledge consultation; this does not turn the relation into a formal office or continuous co-presence.

note.zh-CN: 关系边界是书信与咨询，不等同于长期同处建康。
note.en: The relation is bounded by correspondence and consultation, not long-term co-presence in Jiankang.

label.zh-CN: 以建康为南朝宫廷空间
label.en: Based the Southern Dynasties court in Jiankang

summary.zh-CN: 建康是梁武帝统治和宫廷宗教政策的城市尺度锚点。
summary.en: Jiankang is the city-scale anchor for Liang Wudi's rule and court religious policy.

label.zh-CN: 推动佛教制度与宫廷赞助
label.en: Drove Buddhist institutions and court patronage

summary.zh-CN: 梁武帝是事件的政策主体；后世宗教称号与制度史事实保持区分。
summary.en: Liang Wudi is the policy actor in this event; later religious titles remain distinct from institutional history.

label.zh-CN: 发生于建康宫廷空间
label.en: Located in the Jiankang court setting

summary.zh-CN: 事件以建康作为南朝宫廷和寺院制度的城市尺度地点。
summary.en: The event uses Jiankang as the city-scale setting of the Southern Dynasties court and monastery institutions.

label.zh-CN: 在长安参与历法与知识制度
label.en: Worked in Chang'an's calendrical and knowledge institutions

summary.zh-CN: 长安是一行参与唐代国家历法与知识制度的城市尺度锚点。
summary.en: Chang'an is the city-scale anchor for Yixing's participation in Tang calendrical and knowledge institutions.

label.zh-CN: 参与大衍历编纂工程
label.en: Participated in the Dayan calendar project

summary.zh-CN: 一行是大衍历事件中的僧侣—技术知识主体；编纂团队与制度过程不归于单一人物。
summary.en: Yixing is the monastic–technical knowledge actor in the Dayan calendar event; team production and institutional process are not assigned to one figure alone.

label.zh-CN: 连接长安国家制度空间
label.en: Connected with Chang'an state institutions

summary.zh-CN: 长安是大衍历工程的国家制度锚点；事件不把所有观测点压缩为长安单点。
summary.en: Chang'an is the state-institution anchor for the Dayan calendar project; the event does not reduce every observation site to one Chang'an point.

label.zh-CN: 同时代知识网络并置
label.en: Parallel figures in a contemporary knowledge network

summary.zh-CN: 一行与司马承祯处于唐代宗教、宫廷和知识制度的相邻时间层；本条不暗示二人直接会面或共同项目。
summary.en: Yixing and Sima Chengzhen occupy adjacent layers of Tang religious, court and knowledge institutions; this does not imply a direct meeting or shared project.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 7–8 世纪之交的同时代层
displayDate.en: Contemporary layer around the seventh–eighth century transition

note.zh-CN: 同时代并置，不等同于直接交往。
note.en: A contemporary parallel, not direct interaction.

label.zh-CN: 在庐山推动书院复兴
label.en: Promoted academy revival at Mount Lu

summary.zh-CN: 庐山是朱熹与白鹿洞书院、儒学教育和跨时代文化景观相连的现实地点。
summary.en: Mount Lu is the real place connecting Zhu Xi with the White Deer Grotto Academy, Confucian education and a cross-era cultural landscape.

label.zh-CN: 与武夷山讲学传统相连
label.en: Connected with the Wuyi teaching tradition

summary.zh-CN: 武夷山作为山地文化景观连接朱熹讲学和书院网络；坐标不代表所有讲学地点。
summary.en: The Wuyi landscape connects Zhu Xi with teaching and academy networks; the coordinate does not represent every teaching site.

label.zh-CN: 推动白鹿洞书院复兴
label.en: Promoted the White Deer Grotto Academy revival

summary.zh-CN: 朱熹是书院复兴事件的主要人物；书院制度、文集和后世影响保持为不同层次。
summary.en: Zhu Xi is the principal figure in the academy revival; institution, collected writings and later influence remain separate layers.

label.zh-CN: 发生于庐山白鹿洞文化景观
label.en: Located in the Mount Lu White Deer Grotto landscape

summary.zh-CN: 白鹿洞书院复兴以庐山为现实地点锚点，并与东林寺的东晋层次分开。
summary.en: The academy revival uses Mount Lu as its real-place anchor and remains distinct from Donglin's Eastern Jin layer.

label.zh-CN: 在庐山文化景观中跨时代并置
label.en: Placed across time within the Mount Lu cultural landscape

summary.zh-CN: 朱熹与慧远相隔数百年；关系比较的是同一山地文化景观中的教育与宗教制度记忆，不是人物交往。
summary.en: Zhu Xi and Huiyuan were separated by centuries; the relation compares educational and religious institutional memory in one mountain landscape, not personal interaction.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 386–1191 年的跨时代文化景观层

note.zh-CN: 比较关系，不是同时代人物关系。
note.en: A comparative relation, not a contemporary personal relation.

label.zh-CN: 进入孔子经典传统的理学接受层
label.en: Entered the Neo-Confucian reception of Confucian classics associated with Confucius

summary.zh-CN: 该关系表示朱熹对先秦经典和孔子传统的后世解释与接受，不把宋代思想回写为先秦现场。
summary.en: This records Zhu Xi's later interpretation and reception of early Confucian classics associated with Confucius without projecting Song thought back into the early scene.

label.zh-CN: 进入孟子经典传统的理学接受层
label.en: Entered the Neo-Confucian reception of the Mencius tradition

summary.zh-CN: 关系表示朱熹对孟子传统的宋代理学重释，不把后世经典地位倒写成战国时期的自觉结构。
summary.en: The relation records Zhu Xi's Song Neo-Confucian re-reading of the Mencius tradition without projecting later canonical status back into the Warring States period.
